what: Median land surface temperature of summer mornings, by 60 m cell (Landsat 8 and 9)
source: USGS Landsat 8 and 9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface temperature (ST_B10) and QA_PIXEL, 244 scenes of June to September 2024-2026 with less than 70% cloud cover, read from Microsoft Planetary Computer at 60 m; the median of each cell's clear views
